Subject: Pan-EU co-sell demo — timezone routing & ops runbook

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for coordinating the joint demo. A couple of constraints surfaced on our side as we pull together the runbook and calendar:

- The prospect (Aurelia Systems) is in CET/CEST; they asked for a late-morning session (10:30–11:30 CET).
- Our EU marketplace technical lead (Tom) has a hard block at that time but could join at 15:00 CET.
- Cloudwave ops has requested we include an explicit routing/fallback plan if EU capacity is constrained (they run in multiple AZs across frankfurt and ireland).

Attached is a first-pass runbook (EU_CoSell_Runbook_v1.pdf) and a tentative .ics I generated for 2027-06-08 10:30 CET. Can you confirm:

1) Whether 10:30 CET works for your SI delivery team and the prospect?
2) If not, please propose the latest slot that still includes the EU-based AWS Marketplace engineer (Tom).

I CC'd Vanessa and Karthik for visibility — Vanessa, quick ask: if we need to shift, can you approve the alternate 15:00 CET slot? We want to avoid a second-week reschedule with the customer.

Thanks —

Jonas
Jonas Weber | Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the runbook. Quick notes from Cloudwave ops: 10:30 CET is fine for our SI delivery team, but the prospect engineers are asking for 15:00 CET due to an internal deployment review that morning.

If shifting to 15:00 CET works for Redwood, we can update the invite and share an ops checklist (I can attach the finalized checklist by EOD).

> Tom is available at 15:00 CET and has confirmed he'll attend if we move — he also requested we include a short "marketplace flows" segment focused on procurement hooks (10 minutes).

Sounds good to me. A couple of technical notes from Engineering Ops:

- Our EU-serving capacity is pinned to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 for this demo (to keep latency under 80ms for the prospect).
- If we shift to 15:00 CET, we should enable the fallback policy in the runbook: route to the eu-west-1 variant first; if token latency exceeds 150ms, failover to the eu-central-1 replica and reduce batch size for interactive mode.
- I'll attach a minimal calendar .ics with both slots (10:30 CET / 15:00 CET) so the customer and partners can pick.

Action items:
- Jonas: confirm customer preference (Priya said they prefer 15:00).
- Priya: confirm final ops-checklist and send to me so I can add the routing snippet to the runbook.

Thanks —
Karthik

Team —

I approve moving to 15:00 CET (I prefer we have Tom on for the marketplace segment). A few coordination notes:

- Please keep the customer-facing runbook to a single page for the demo — the technical appendix can be separate. The one-page should list who speaks for which segment (Redwood product, Cloudwave SI delivery, AWS marketplace).
- Marissa, can you confirm we have a single point of contact at Aurelia for calendar updates? We don't want multiple invites floating.
- Jonas, if Priya confirms 15:00, lock the calendar and loop in Product Operations for the post-demo follow-up recording and a short survey.

If there's any pushback from the prospect, we'll offer the 10:30 slot but mark it as "no marketplace lead" — that keeps momentum without delaying procurement review.
